final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), store_avgs AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS store_avg FROM rental_totals WHERE total IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total) AS kept_total, AVG(rt.total - sa.store_avg) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals rt JOIN store_avgs sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.total > sa.store_avg GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id
